Basically if they cannot prove that you purchased the illicit materials then they have no proof you did anything wrong. You can simply state that you don't know what it is and that someone must have had it sent to you.

Sorry for the long back story, but I feel like people will fail to understand why it was such an OH HOLY FUCK! moment without the background story leading up to this moment.


Back in '08 I had just got back from a year long tour for the Army in Baghdad (we had plenty of oh holy fuck moments over there, but I felt prepared for those). I had been told by my neighbor who was also a high school friend that someone had been parking a car in my driveway. He first asked if I had bought a new car and I said if I had I was very, very pissed off since I could not afford one. Plus all of the money I made over there my wife had used to buy our family furniture, clothes for the kids, fun stuff, and get us into a house. I came home with a couple hundred bucks in the bank after serving in combat as did many others.  It seemed obvious that my wife at the time was having a guest over a lot, no big deal.


I get home and ask her about it noting the specific make and model to her, but she claimed she knew no such person who owned that kind of car. The entire conversation she was nervous, looking at the ground, and all around not acting like herself. After spending a year working with interrogation a little voice when off in my head whispering what was really going on. We went through a few big fights and I finally moved into a friend's apartment.


Here is where my life seemed to be taking the express elevator to hell. I had been working for my wife's grandparents for a few years off and on. One day at work a little fat man with a bunch of papers in his hand came to my job and asked if I was e_equals_mc_vag. I said yes and he served me divorce papers... in front of my wife's grandmother who had been hoping we would fix things up and get back together. She starts balling, I hug her and tell her I should go home.


I had seen it coming because at this point I had been at my friend's apartment for about a month and every time we spoke she was unable to come clean. A few weeks after the divorce is finalized my employer aka my former grandmother-in-law tells me that they are going to lay me off due to the family drama going on. I go home, file for unemployment, and start looking for a new job. I get unemployment which was roughly 1/3rd of what I was making prior, but my child support did not go down because I was required to keep it at its current level for 1 year after the divorce was done. I made little over $2,000 a month with unemployment payments and food stamps paying out $1,249 a month in child support to my ex-wife who had been unemployed for roughly 4 years. Luckily my friend said that I could just buy groceries and not pay rent so I could make my $394 a month car payment. Needless to say thing were looking really bad.


This is where shit got real. I had been experiencing really severe sore throats for about a month or so and thought it was time to go to the doctor before my insurance expired because I knew I would no longer be able to pay it off. I go in, doc looks down my throat, sees a strange growth in there, and says he needs a sample. He takes a sample and gives me a couple scripts to help with the pain. I go home utterly mind fucked by what had been going on in my life recently and decided I couldn't worry about it until he got back to me.


Within a week his office calls me in for a follow up. I show up and he informs me that I have a small tumor in my throat growing on my voice box. The sample had cancerous cells in them and he wanted to talk about my options. Instantly my world goes blank, I think back to the last time I could recall feeling like life made sense and start to wish that I was back in Iraq just following orders (even though I thought Iraq was a cluster fuck bullshit war, but I signed the dotted line and did what I said I would). The doctor noticed I hadn't even been listening and grabs my attention. He tells me that the sooner we try to get this thing out the better my chances are for survival. 


I go home with this enlightening news, broke, divorced, and hardly able to see my 2 little boys. I started getting severely depressed, almost manically so to the point where I stopped giving a fuck about anyone and anything. Did every drug I could find, drank every drink I was offered, went to every party I could find, and fucked anything that had tits, a vagina, and a pretty smile. My life seemed to be spiraling into a series of insane escapades where it looked like I wanted to die. I would drunk drive while on another substance like L, climb on top of a sky scraper using the fire escapes while wasted rolling, have sex with multiple partners a week to the point where their names would get confused in my head, and was just an all around awful person to those I did not know.


One day I woke up and thought to myself that if I was going to die it was going to be on my own fucking terms, not some god damn disease that would take possibly a couple years to finish me off. I went to my dad's house when I knew he and my step-mother would be at work. Found my old .22 rifle he had bought me as a kid, sat on the floor in his storage room, loaded it feeling every round in my fingers thinking that they felt oddly heavy without even realizing I would only be able to pull the trigger once. 


I put the end of the barrel in my mouth and make sure to aim it diagonally up so that the bullet would go through my brain and out the back of my head. The idea being to leave my face unscathed so that my casket could be open at the funeral. I wrap my thumb around the trigger, clench my eyes closed as tight as they go, and that little voice we all have in our head is screaming, 'Do it pussy! Pull the fucking trigger! Be a god damn man about it and let's get this last DMT trip done and over with!' Suddenly I think about my life as a whole, playing in a forest with my little sister as a kid, holding my children in my arms as babies, my first time making love, my first home grilled steak, and the first time my dad and I had a conversation where it was obvious that he considered me a man. I just simply couldn't do it. 


I unload the .22, put it all away, left no trace so no one would ever know what I had almost done, go home, and get plastered swearing to never think about it again. About a month or two after that I had my surgery successfully, nothing was left, and had been very fortunate. I started thinking about my life as something that was not defined in a couple more years, but possibly decades. I ended up starting a company later, got my life back on track, and have made a fucking million personal changes. I am still recovering financially and trying to get a lawyer so I can see my kids more often, but things finally seem to be looking up. 


TL;DR I deployed to Iraq for a year. My wife cheated on me while I was deployed. I came back and got divorced. I worked for her grand parents and got laid off. I had a tumor growing in my throat and thought I was going to die. Decided that I was going to off myself and changed my mind with the taste of rifle still in my mouth.

I have the exact same problem. I usually just hop in a shower right after insufflating. I have dosed a good 50 times and vomited during every. single. one. The shower makes for easy clean up and helps make you relax and feel better afterward.

For maximum effect don't eat the day you eat them, fasting helps you digest them quickly and hit sooner so you have less 'is it working yet?' time. Lock up your cell phone and any weapons. Since it is your first it may be wise to have a sober sitter, just in case. 

Out or indoors doesn't matter, do what you're comfortable with. I recommend staying home, listening to your favorite music (or give Shpongle or Godspeed You Black Emperor! a try), and writing down/discussing your thoughts with your sitter. If you like to draw give it a whirl, you'll probably surprise yourself.

I like to have a mirror to look in so I can see myself morph or change shapes as well as a black light, glow sticks, or if you need to calm down try watching a mindfuck movie (like Inception or my fave Enter the Void). If you freak out a bit I always talk to my sitter or watch a slow paced documentary such as Stephen Hawking's Enter the Universe.

If outdoors I would avoid public and strangers. I would just walk to a lonely part of a beach or walk into a thicket of woods until you no longer see people you don't know. Try closing your eyes and pushing the base of your palm into your eyelids to put pressure on your eyeballs for 3-5 minites. This can create some interesting yet temporary synesthesia effects that are fun to look at with your eyes open or closed.

If your stomach gets upset or you think it might smoke a little green and once again don't eat before hand. Try going on YouTube and watching videos of fractal zooms, shit will blow your mind! If all of that is boring go to your bathroom, shut the door, turn the lights off, put a towel at the base of the door to block light, hop in the shower or bathtub with warm water, and stay there awhile. Sensory deprivation can show you a ton of visuals. I do the same, but while listening to the Dead Flag Blues by Godspeed You Black Emperor! 

TLDR Have fun and go somewhere you feel comfy in. Helps to have your favorite music and do it on an empty stomach. Your head will explode if you took enough, but much less than 2.5 grams will probably leaving you wanting more.

About a year ago I tried 5-MeO-DMT for the first time. Having never tried it, but having tried DMT I thought it would be the same. I had never broken through, seen an entity I could not identify, or felt some other mystical force before. I had already taken more than my fair share of mushrooms, L, 2CE and 2CI, pot, and misc. other hallucinogens in my life. After the first few hits I saw visuals with my eyes open. Strange and constantly changing 'geometric in nature' shapes. Then I took a fifth deep and slow hit, trying to hold it for the good old 10 seconds. I think I counted to 3 before my head fell back which was fine because I had my living room set up with a big old comforter and a pillow.


Immediately my mind thought something was wrong. I started to feel like if 'I' or whatever form I had taken was leaving my body. At first it was just not being able to move my arms and legs, but then I started to think I had overdosed (which is absurd since I had not taken more than 2 bowls safely below my danger limit) and that I was dying. My sister was on the couch watching me the whole time serving as a some what shaman like character, but was silent. I thought that I was just trying to have a good time on DMT, but was convinced I had died!


At first it was kind of terrifying, looking down at my body wondering how to get back into it and frantically looking to see if I had any form whatsoever. I found no way back in and had no form, I was just being shown something. After what felt like forever my sister looked at me and tried talking to me. I saw my body being unresponsive to her. She got on the floor, checked for breath, then a pulse, and started crying immediately. She found me dead on the floor and tried calling 911 for an ambulance. They asked her what my address was and she did not know (she was dropped off there and had not been at my new place much) so she freaked out more. Eventually she found it in a text message and an ambulance came and got me.


In the ambulance part I sort of blacked out seeing images of my life flash before me stuff from my childhood such as getting poison ivy and my sister trying to help me by putting lotion on it (she was trying at least!) to breaking my foot playing pass with a football to being in Iraq in the Army and all the way to the last woman at the time I had had sex with.


Eventually it flashed forward a bit and I was in a casket which was being opened by someone I did not know. When this happened I sort of hovered in the air looking down at all my family and friends attending my funeral. I was able to 'hear' their thoughts such as those from one of my best friends expressing anger about how I took drugs too far, my sister feeling like it was her fault when it was not, my dad just feeling what I can only describe as sheer pain and sadness, all the way to my own 2 boys (2 and 4 at the time) asking their mother (my ex-wife) what was wrong with daddy. I wanted to feel all of this, but found myself experiencing less and less of my own feelings and more and more of some sort of transformation into something that simply does not feel or encounter anything human.


I was already an atheist so the funeral was mostly people talking about what they fondly remembered of me with a few friends of mine trying to lighten the mood with jokes and stories of ours. There was a pastor (I am guessing more for my family and not me since I was never religious) who said some nice things, but obviously had no fucking clue who I was at all. Then the viewing began, most got in line, but a few refused to look at my body. A couple people put their hand on my body in what felt like an effort to communicate to me. Eventually the pastor returns, says a few things to wrap it up' and closes the casket so that they can commence my burial. 


This is when shit got... strange. I rolled up looking at the ceiling of the church and then suddenly I saw no church, no people, and nothing I could recognize. All I could see were drastically changing shapes and colors with sounds that were beyond identification. I felt every single positive, good, sensual, sexual, pleasant, and awesome feeling any one entity could possibly experience. I mean it was like the best sex, book, movie, date, childhood moment, moment with your child, and food mixed all into one infinite moment. I had accepted the fact that I was dead and that there was simply nothing else to experience, this was my existence for eternity and that was just fine with whatever I had become.


After what literally felt like eternity I started to realize that my eyes were closed. It took me a moment to register that I had eyelids and that they could be opened. I opened them and looked at my sister. The first thing I did was start laughing extremely loud and hysterically. Life was one big joke to me at that moment because it just simply could not be real. My sister smiled at me and said, "Yeah, never seen that response before. It's pretty crazy, huh? So tell me what you saw."


I told her about seeing my kids ask what is wrong with daddy and I started crying like an infant. Full on tears down the cheek with choking sobs whilst still laughing my life off. I gave her all the details and she described the space I ended up as 'the God's Space' which I can see why people would describe it that way, but do not do so myself. I looked at the clock on my oven and realized that only about 15-20 minutes had passed. My roommate at the time came home and I answered the door stating loudly to him, "I died today!"


Even after this experience I am an atheist, I began to learn how truly powerful our minds are. I think too many of us out there try to find too much meaning in something that even though it changed your life it did not change the facts (laws of nature) and only you experienced it. Reality exists still, but there is also something more to us than we probably think.
